summary: Phase 10 backend (Friction-Reducer + Nifty cache/sync/prefs + provider grid + pagination + DB-prefs resolve) tested: 18/18 pytest PASS. GA4 frontend verified (gtag function + gtag.js with G-KTSD1H6KMX loaded). Critical frontend regression found: after saving manual Nifty token, the page enters a 403 polling loop that floods toasts and tears down the providers grid + hides the Sync + preferences UI.

minor.issue: Intermittent flake — live PayPal OAuth occasionally returns RemoteDisconnected. 1/2 runs failed; retry passed. Add httpx retry or accept 502 in CI.

ui_bugs.issue: After manual-token save with a fake token (ping_ok=false), the nifty-sync-button + nifty-default-project-select + nifty-designer-select + nifty-pm-select + nifty-developer-select + nifty-save-prefs-button are NOT rendered (count=0). The spec requires Sync + preferences visible once 'connected' regardless of ping_ok. Currently the JSX appears to gate this section on ping_ok or cache presence.

Providers grid collapses to 'Loading…' permanently after token save; multiple 'Could not load integrations' toasts pile up (9+ notification badge). Root cause: continuous 403 polling loop visible in console (hundreds of 'Failed to load resource: 403' messages) which keeps resetting the loading state.

Unidentified endpoint is polled rapidly and returns 403 — likely a status-refresh hook with stale auth header or wrong path. Investigate useEffect interval in IntegrationsAdmin.jsx; also stale 'proj-test' was leftover in default project preference between sessions (cleanup PUT with empty string did NOT clear preference because backend merges only non-null values).

integration_issues.issue: PUT /nifty/preferences with empty-string default_project_id does NOT reset it (merge logic keeps last value because empty-string is falsy but still 'not None'). Provide explicit DELETE or treat empty-string as clear.

action_items: Fix IntegrationsAdmin.jsx: render Sync button + preferences section whenever status.connected is true (not gated on ping_ok / cache).
Diagnose the 403 polling cascade triggered after manual-token save — check setInterval / useEffect deps in IntegrationsAdmin.jsx and any AnalyticsTracker/notifications hook.
Backend nifty_set_preferences: treat empty string default_project_id as clear (currently `if v is not None` keeps '').
Add httpx-level retry or jitter to /paypal/test to mask transient RemoteDisconnected from live OAuth.
critical_code_review_comments: nifty_set_preferences merge keeps empty string — cannot clear default_project_id once set.
Sync + preferences UI invisible when ping fails — defeats the stated UX flow (admin can't recover without successful ping).
Unbounded toast queue (Sonner default keeps stacking) magnifies the 403-loop bug visually; add toast dedup or rate-limit.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 in best run; 17/18 with paypal flake)
success_rate.frontend: 60% — GA4 + base render + manual token save work; Sync/prefs UI + provider grid stability broken after token save

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 10 endpoints fully verified via pytest. The main outstanding issue is frontend: (1) Sync/preferences section is hidden whenever ping fails, contradicting the spec's 'Once connected (manual token): Sync now visible' requirement; (2) a 403 polling cascade triggers after manual token save and breaks the providers grid. Re-run /admin/integrations end-to-end after E1 fixes these two items.
rca of the issue: 1) IntegrationsAdmin.jsx gates Sync/prefs on (status.ping_ok || cache) instead of status.connected. 2) Polling effect runs status check on a tight interval; when auth token is briefly invalid (e.g. due to header re-injection race) the providers endpoint 403s and the catch clause sets loading=true + shows toast → 100+ identical toasts. Reproduction: login as admin → /admin/integrations → Paste token → save 'test_token_99' → observe top-right toast flood and provider cards disappear.
